title: Syntax
explain: A Java program is made of classes, and execution starts in `public static void main`. Statements end with a semicolon, blocks use curly braces, and the file name must match the public class. From Java 11 you can run a single file directly with `java Main.java`.
exercise: Print your name and age on separate lines using `println`, then print both again with one `printf`.
tip: When you compile with `javac`, the file name must match the public class name exactly, including capital letters.
